_comment: Does a movie execute code the static census still misses? Regenerate: tools/phase4_coverage_runtime_probe.py
watch_kind: range (execTrace.addRangeWatch) -- full coverage of each gap
method_limits: Coverage of the gaps is COMPLETE -- one range watch per gap via execTrace.addRangeWatch, not a sample. The limit is the MOVIE, not the instrument: a hit proves the gap is live code, a miss only says this recording did not execute it. Silence is never proof that a region is dead.
verdict: NO GAP CODE OBSERVED -- controls fired, so the instrument worked, and NONE of the 9 uncovered gaps executed anywhere in this movie (full range coverage, not a sample). Consistent with the residual being error paths, unused library code, or data -- but NOT proof of it: another recording could still reach them.
